jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, our annual revenue is in the hundreds of millions USD and millions use our browser on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place.


Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!


Your Team and Role

Working on the Backend Functional Team, you'll lead complex projects across key company-wide objectives. Using Perl (Version 5), Go, and Node.js, youâll write pragmatic, performant, testable code that works consistently, and work on related projects. Recent projects include:

  • Implementing AI-assisted answers and integrating them into our Search product while maintaining our privacy-first approach

  • Delivering improvements to Duck.ai to help us make it a competitive AI chat alternative for both free and paying users

  • Implementing sophisticated data processing pipelines that maintain search relevancy


As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll collaborate remotely with your peers and take responsibility for solving product issues impacting our all-in-one privacy solution, whether large or small. In time, you'll formally mentor other engineers, supporting their career growth and the growth of the Backend Team at DuckDuckGo.


About You

  • 7+ years of professional experience, primarily focused on backend systems that power consumer-facing products

  • Product acumen to reason about technical tradeoffs in terms of user impact

  • Familiarity with AI agent tooling: evaluation frameworks, RAG pipelines and prompt engineering

  • A fundamental understanding of complex data structures and algorithms â you can develop and apply new solutions and confidently navigate and improve existing code.

  • Data-driven analytical skills for decision-making, stakeholder alignment, and experiment-oriented delivery

  • Solid project management abilities

  • Excellent written and verbal communication to validate and articulate decisions

  • Previous experience leading and mentoring experienced engineers, supporting their career goals, and unlocking their potential.


Compensation

This role is paid on a regional pay scale, in local currency, and stock options:

  • United States: $190,500 USD annually

  • United Kingdom: Â£134,600 GBP annually

  • Canada: C$253,500 CAD annually

  • Europe/Rest of World: â¬157,350 EUR annually

In Spain, pay is expected to transition to the EUR scale on January 1, 2027, and in other Europe/Rest of World countries on February 1, 2027.


Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.


Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.


Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.



Hiring Process

Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire.


Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any typeÂ on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.


We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to careers@duckduckgo.com to let us know the nature of your request.


Please note that:

  • Youâll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing

  • Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.

  • While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.

  • A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.

  • By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.


Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process

As part of our commitment to enhancing our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing and summarizing job applications and test projects, including those tools integrated into our recruitment vendor platforms. We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicantsâ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.

All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to the use of AI technology in our review process. If you would like to request an alternative selection process, please contact us as at careers@duckduckgo.com. Thank you for your interest in joining DuckDuckGo!

jobs.title: Clinical Data Manager
jobs.description:
General Summary
The temporary Clinical Data Manager acts as a lead data manager for one or more projects, applies data management experience to clinical trials, and utilizes functional knowledge of the logistics of clinical trials to ensure the quality and integrity of clinical trial data. The CDM works on multi-functional teams and supports clinical trial projects as a departmental subject matter expert (SME).

We are seeking a temporary clinical data manager who can dedicate 20 hours a week to support ongoing study activities. The initial assignment is for 6 months, but may be extended to meet the needs of our Team. Applicants must be eligible to live and work in the US.


Specific Duties and Responsibilities
â¢Independently lead and/or perform all data management activities within an assigned study (e.g., study startup, study conduct, study closeout, and reporting). *
â¢Serve as the data management SME on multidisciplinary project teams providing specific expertise on timeline development, identification of data management deliverables and resource requirements. *
â¢Participate in the creation, review, and maintenance of project timelines and monitor progress of data management activities. *
â¢Provide oversight for Data Management CRO and other vendors to ensure compliance with the protocol, external/internal standards, Good Clinical Practices (GCPs), applicable regulatory guidelines, SOPs, and other relevant guidelines.
â¢Ensure Data Management documentation is filed/archived according to applicable Penumbra and regulatory requirements. *
â¢Interact with data management, biostatistics, Clinical Affairs and Medical Affairs team to ensure integrity and quality of data. *
â¢Contribute ideas to the development of the department, identifying areas for improvement (e.g., SOPs, processes)
â¢Participates in audits and inspections. *
â¢Attend Investigator Meetings when requested to provide training on CRF data completion.
â¢Responsible for creation of training materials and training of the CRAs to ensure consistency of data entry at the sites. *
â¢Provide DM departmental training and to other teams, as needed.
â¢Utilizes reports to track study progress and ensure timeliness and quality expectations are met.
â¢Adhere to the Companyâs Quality Management System (QMS) as well as domestic and global quality system regulations, standards, and procedures. *
â¢Understand relevant security, privacy and compliance principles and adhere to the regulations, standards, and procedures that are applicable to the Company. *

â¢This position must have experience working on regulatory trials within the medical device and/or pharmaceutical industry
â¢Position requires technical, organizational, analytical, and strong communication skills
â¢Knowledge of regulatory guidelines pertaining to data quality and data management

â¢Knowledge of continuous improvement, project management, change management, and risk management
â¢Medical device, pharmaceutical, biotech, or other regulated industry experience required
â¢Proficiency with MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

 

Working Conditions
â¢General office environment
â¢Willingness and ability to work on site.
â¢May have business travel from 0% - 5% to conferences and/or other Penumbra affiliated facilities.
â¢Potential exposure to blood-borne pathogens
â¢Requires some lifting and moving of up to 25 pounds
â¢Must be able to move between buildings and floors.
â¢Must be able to remain stationary and use a computer or other standard office equipment, such as a printer or copy machine, for an extensive period of time each day.
â¢Must be able to read, prepare emails, and produce documents and spreadsheets.
â¢Must be able to move within the office and access file cabinets or supplies, as needed.
â¢Must be able to communicate and exchange accurate information with employees at all levels on a daily basis. Must be able to communicate and exchange accurate information with employees at all levels on a daily basis.

 

Base Pay Range Per Hour: $50.00 - $80.00
Individual compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location.

\n


\n

What We Offer

jobs.title: Software Engineer AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.


How it works

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.


Requirements

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering
  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)


Nice to have

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments


Terms

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork


Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

jobs.title: Associate Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Description

Machine Learning Maestro: You donât just work with data - you decode it, predict the future with it, and turn it into action. Your models donât just sit on a shelf - they shape strategy, optimize efficiency, and fuel company growth. You thrive on uncovering hidden patterns, validating hypotheses, and embedding machine learning models into real-world AI applications. If that sounds like you - read on.

AlgaeCal is looking for a top-tier Associate Data Scientist who can turn raw information into strategies that drive measurable results.

This job will give you ALL the feels:

At AlgaeCal, weâre driven by a single idea. To end the fear of bone loss. In the United States, an estimated 54 million people have low bone density.

The good news? AlgaeCal has the worldâs only clinically-backed natural solution to this problem. We give hope to everyone worried about bone loss. If that excites you, youâll find no better place to continue your career than at AlgaeCal.

This job might be for you if youâve gotâ¦

  • Experience as a Data Scientist (or a similar role) and can back it up with a resume that shows real results. Youâve built predictive models, optimized AI applications, and refined data architectures that have had a measurable impact. You donât just analyze numbersâyou translate data into actionable insights that drive business decisions.
  • Serious coding skills in Python or R. You know how to build and refine machine learning models that actually work. Youâve used statistical modeling and data science tools to solve complex problems and unlock growth opportunities.
  • Expertise in SQL and relational databases. Writing efficient queries? Optimizing data structures? Your resume is packed with quantifiable examples thatâll make us drool with desire! You know how to work with large datasets, ensuring data is organized, accessible, and primed for analysis.
  • A deep understanding of machine learning algorithms. Whether itâs regression, clustering, or neural networks, you know how to choose the right approach for the right challenge. You donât just apply modelsâyou understand how they work under the hood.
  • Hands-on experience with data warehouses. BigQuery or similar? Check. You understand how to design, maintain, and optimize scalable data storage solutions that support robust analytics.
  • A knack for standardizing and improving data models. Youâve worked with data at scale, refining schemas and improving architectures to ensure efficiency, accuracy, and usability across the organization.
  • A laser-sharp eye for detail. Youâre the kind of person who spots trends, outliers, and opportunities that others miss. Your ability to catch anomalies helps ensure our models and analytics are always on point.
  • An entrepreneurial approach to data. You donât just crunch numbersâyou think strategically about how data can be leveraged to create business value. Youâre proactive in identifying new ways AI and machine learning can drive efficiency, sales, and profitability.
  • Industry know-how that adds value. If youâve got experience in consumer packaged goods, e-commerce, or the health/supplement industry, thatâs a huge plus. You understand how data can shape customer experience, optimize operations, and maximize ROI.

Now, time to be honest: is this really you? If youâre nodding your head and feeling that flutter of excitement, then we canât wait to meet you.

Other Qualities Youâll Need

At AlgaeCal weâre going to insist that you have these 3 qualities:

  • Youâre humbleââyou put the team and othersâ needs ahead of your own
  • Youâre hungry to learn more
  • Youâre people smartââin the sense that youâre a great teammate

The truth is, if you donât have these qualities you wonât last long at AlgaeCal. So if youâre missing one of them, be honest. Save yourself a lot of headaches and skip to a job posting that is a better fit for you.

What Will You Earn?

We believe in rewarding top talent. Letâs talk about salary once weâve had the chance to get to know you better. Rest assured, weâre generous and offer above-market pay for the right person. If you bring the skills and experience, weâll make sure the compensation reflects that.

Youâll also enjoy the following benefits:

  • Monthly team events and activities
  • Weekly team lunches
  • Casual dress code
  • Incredible dog friendly, Yaletown office one block from SkyTrain
  • Remote working is okay with us too.

And above all, youâll join a team that youâll never want to leave. Culture is everything to us. Yes, we work extremely hard to change as many peopleâs lives as possible. But we know how to have fun and reward ourselves too.

How To Apply

So, do you have what it takes to become the next member of team AlgaeCal?

Job opportunities like this donât come along often, and weâve got a lot to offer our successful applicant. So, to make sure our future Associate Data Scientist is the real-deal, will be a great fit, and will thrive at AlgaeCal, we ask a little more than your run-of-the-mill job application:

If this sounds like a position for you, please respond to this advertisement with your resume and cover letter. Please, read carefully:

1. Write a cover letter addressing:

  • Why are you the best Associate Data Scientist for this role? Give quantifiable examples of related achievements.
  • Describe why you fit perfectly with our values. Read them here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1deCCJZ6tiDiOSlr_W0UdCuM_V_ahzPBs/view
  • What's the toughest challenge youâve ever overcome in your life? How did you overcome it?
  • What are the last three books youâve read?
  • What do you do for fun?

    • 2. Explain what youâre doing now for a job:

  • If you donât have one, explain why.
  • If you have one, explain why youâre looking elsewhere.

jobs.description:
About Us:

Wrapbook is the AI platform for production finance. Weâre building a system of action that puts finance teams in control of their whole production, from payroll, to spend, to accounting.

Built for feature films, TV, and commercials, Wrapbook is trusted by teams at Netflix, Paramount, Anonymous Content, and more. With backing from Andreessen Horowitz, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Jeffrey Katzenberg's WndrCo, our team of 350+ is using AI to transform how finance teams work and empower them to do more with less.

The Opportunity: Senior Software Engineer II, Applied AI (Remote - USA / Canada)

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer II, Applied AI to join our Agentic Systems team, where you'll build AI agents that automate workflows for teams across Wrapbook. You'll partner directly with internal teams like Marketing, Sales, Support, Operations and Finance to find high-leverage processes, then design, ship and iterate on agents that take real work off their plates. This is a chance to define how a 400+ person company runs on AI. You'll see the impact of your work every day, while shaping the patterns, tools and standards for how we build agents at Wrapbook.

What Youâll Do:

  • Design and build production-grade AI agents with LangGraph that automate multi-step workflows for internal teams across Wrapbook

  • Deploy, run and scale agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, using its runtime, memory, identity and gateway capabilities to make them secure and reliable, while tracking what they cost to run and keeping it efficient as usage grows

  • Partner with internal teams to find high-impact workflows, draw out requirements from people who can't hand you a spec, and turn them into agent-driven solutions, explaining clearly what each agent can and can't reliably do

  • Integrate agents with Wrapbook's internal systems, APIs and third-party tools so they can take real actions, not just answer questions

  • Build evaluation, observability and guardrail frameworks to measure agent quality, catch failures and keep humans in the loop where it matters

  • Establish reusable patterns, shared tools and best practices that let the Agentic Systems team ship new agents quickly and consistently

  • Own agents end to end, from prototype to production, measuring their impact on the teams they serve and iterating based on usage data and feedback

  • Drive adoption through clear documentation, training and enablement, so teams understand what each agent does, trust it and know how to get the most from it

What Youâll Have:

  • 6+ years of back-end development experience with Python, TypeScript/Node.js or Java, with a track record of delivering systems built for security, scalability, availability and performance

  • Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM-powered agents or workflows (with models such as Claude, GPT, Llama or Mistral), including prompting, tool use and structured outputs. You can walk us through one you built: how it was designed, what broke and how you fixed it

  • Production experience with at least one agent or LLM framework, such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex or AutoGen, and a solid understanding of AI architectures like RAG, reranking and multi-agent orchestration. Experience with LangGraph specifically is a plus

  • A security-first mindset: you think about data access, permissions and failure modes in everything you build, especially when agents can take real actions

  • Strong product sense and communication skills, with the ability to work directly with non-technical teams to understand their workflows and turn them into reliable automation

  • Comfort with ambiguity and an ownership mentality: you can take a loosely defined problem from idea to production on your own

  • Nice to have: experience running AWS workloads in production and knowing how to design for, deploy on and get the most out of Amazon's services, ideally including Amazon Bedrock AgentCore

Why Join Us:

At Wrapbook, creativity meets technology â and not just in the product.
